tools.name: estimate
tools.description: Declare how long the task will take before any other tool call of the task. The harness scales the estimate by how far past estimates ran, shows the budget to the user, and asks for a report at 1/3, 1/2, 2/3 and 5/6 of it. Call it again to revise the estimate.

tools.name: report
tools.description: File a progress report against the time budget: what is verified done, what is open, and the extra minutes the open items need. The harness projects the finish from it.

tools.name: grant
tools.description: Give a running subagent more minutes on its time budget, after reading its report.
